name: Forms that don't lose people
need: Validation, recovery and review steps that keep long or high-stakes forms from failing people.

name: Safe destructive actions and secrets
need: Deletes, revokes, elevated modes and one-time secrets with friction that matches the real risk.

name: Honest system states
need: Waits, refusals, locks, pauses and sync states that say what is really happening.

name: AI you can check
need: Sources, interpretation, authorship, confidence and autonomy made visible for AI features.

name: Trust and privacy
need: Look-alike detection, consent-first embeds, environment and identity guards, honest prices and audiences.

name: Monitoring without alert fatigue
need: Alerts that decay, absences that alarm and walls that say where to look.

name: Numbers that explain themselves
need: Figures shown with how they are computed, against what, and at a human scale.

name: Power-user navigation
need: Keyboard targeting, return threads, trails and off-screen cues for dense apps.
